edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to the owner state variable.
msg.sender becomes the privileged owner address stored in state.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before completing the ownership handover.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] for the caller.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external callback.
transferOwnership stores the new candidate owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner, changing privilege state.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the handover.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor initializes the name state variable.
Constructor initializes the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets the fixed total supply.
Constructor pre-mints the entire supply into balances of a hardcoded address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer mutates sender and recipient entries in the balances mapping.
approve writes directly into the allowed mapping without a zeroing step.
transferFrom mutates source and destination balances.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall sets the allowance before performing the external callback.
transferAnyERC20Token sweeps foreign tokens to the privileged owner address.
transfer delegates subtraction of the sender balance to safeSub.
transfer delegates addition to the recipient balance to safeAdd.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeSub arithmetic on balances[msg.sender] is reached directly from transfer.
safeAdd arithmetic on balances[to] is reached directly from transfer.
safeSub arithmetic on balances[from] is reached from transferFrom.
safeSub arithmetic on allowed[from][msg.sender] is reached from transferFrom without a prior explicit allowance check.
safeAdd arithmetic on balances[to] is reached from transferFrom.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an arbitrary spender contract, allowing external code to re-enter the token contract before approveAndCall returns.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract whose transfer implementation may re-enter this contract.
safeAdd first operand flows into the overflow-checked addition.
safeAdd second operand flows into the overflow-checked addition.
safeSub minuend parameter feeds the underflow-checked subtraction.
safeSub subtrahend parameter feeds the underflow check require(b <= a).
safeMul first operand feeds the overflow-checked multiplication.
safeMul second operand feeds the overflow-checked multiplication.
safeDiv dividend parameter feeds the division helper.
safeDiv divisor parameter feeds the require(b > 0) division guard.
New owner candidate parameter is written to the newOwner state variable.
Transfer destination parameter indexes the balances mapping.
Transfer amount parameter feeds the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic.
Spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
Allowance amount parameter is stored in the allowed mapping.
Source address parameter indexes balances and allowed in transferFrom.
Destination address parameter is credited in transferFrom.
Token amount parameter feeds all arithmetic in transferFrom.
Queried address parameter indexes the balances mapping.
Token owner parameter is the first key of the allowed mapping lookup.
Spender parameter is the second key of the allowed mapping lookup.
Spender parameter is both stored in allowed and used as the external call target.
Approval amount parameter is stored in allowed and forwarded to the callback.
Arbitrary data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary token contract address parameter becomes the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
Token amount parameter is passed into the external ERC20 transfer call.

normalization_plan.reason: safeAdd.a is a plain parameter of the safeAdd function and carries no independent semantic meaning outside it.
safeAdd.b is a plain parameter of the safeAdd function and carries no independent semantic meaning outside it.
safeSub.a is a plain parameter of the safeSub function and is fully absorbed by that helper.
safeSub.b is a plain parameter of the safeSub function and is fully absorbed by that helper.
safeMul.a is a plain parameter of the safeMul function and is fully absorbed by that helper.
safeMul.b is a plain parameter of the safeMul function and is fully absorbed by that helper.
safeDiv.a is a plain parameter of the safeDiv function and is fully absorbed by that helper.
safeDiv.b is a plain parameter of the safeDiv function and is fully absorbed by that helper.
transferOwnership._newOwner is only used to write the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership.
transfer.to only serves as a balances mapping index inside transfer.
transfer.tokens is only an arithmetic operand inside transfer via safeSub/safeAdd.
approve.spender only serves as an allowed mapping index inside approve.
approve.tokens is only stored into the allowed mapping inside approve.
transferFrom.from only serves as a balances/allowed mapping index inside transferFrom.
transferFrom.to only serves as a balances mapping index inside transferFrom.
transferFrom.tokens only feeds the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic inside transferFrom.
balanceOf.tokenOwner is only a balances mapping lookup key inside balanceOf.
allowance.tokenOwner is only the first lookup key used inside allowance.
allowance.spender is only the second lookup key used inside allowance.
approveAndCall.spender is only used as an allowed mapping key and as the external call target inside approveAndCall.
approveAndCall.tokens is only stored in allowed and forwarded to the external callback inside approveAndCall.
approveAndCall.data is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call inside approveAndCall.
transferAnyERC20Token.tokenAddress is only used as the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token.tokens is only used as the amount argument of the external ERC20 transfer call.
